segments.name: Medical devices
segments.description: Develops, manufactures and sells non-invasive portable home-use ultrasound devices for prenatal care, fertility monitoring and pulmonary applications.
segments.evidence: We currently have two primary products, the Pulsenmore ES and the Pulsenmore FC, and an additional third portable ultrasound solution that is in earlier developmental stages, the Pulsenmore MC.

revenueModel.text: The company derives revenue primarily from sales of its Pulsenmore ES device to healthcare providers and distributors, and in 2025 also recognized revenues from a settlement agreement with GEHC.
revenueModel.evidence: We primarily derive revenue from the sale of our Pulsenmore ES product.
